definitions.gloss: smelting; refining; extraction of metal from ore
definitions.explanation: The industrial process of extracting pure metal from raw ore by heating and chemical treatment. Covers the entire process from raw ore to usable metal.

examples.japanese: {銅|どう}の{製錬|せいれん}を{行|おこな}う。
この{地域|ちいき}はかつて{金|きん}の{製錬|せいれん}で{栄|さか}えた。
examples.english: This area once prospered from gold smelting.

examples.japanese: {製錬|せいれん}{所|じょ}から{出|で}る{煙|けむり}が{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}になった。
examples.english: Smoke from the smelting plant became an environmental problem.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{製錬|せいれん}{技術|ぎじゅつ}によってコストが{下|さ}がった。
examples.english: New smelting technology brought costs down.

notes:
Composed of {製|せい} (manufacture, produce) and {錬|れん} (refine, temper). Refers specifically to the process of extracting metal from ore — the first stage of turning raw mineral resources into usable metals.

The word is distinct from the homophone {精錬|せいれん}, which refers to the further purification of already-extracted metal to achieve higher purity. {製錬|せいれん} = ore → crude metal; {精錬|せいれん} = crude metal → pure metal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {製錬|せいれん}{所|じょ}: smelting plant, smelter
- {製錬|せいれん}{技術|ぎじゅつ}: smelting technology
- {銅|どう}の{製錬|せいれん}: copper smelting
- {製錬|せいれん}する: to smelt, to refine from ore

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {精錬|せいれん}: refining, purification — a later stage that purifies crude metal further; homophone with different kanji
- {冶金|やきん}: metallurgy — the broader science and technology of working with metals
- {鋳造|ちゅうぞう}: casting — shaping molten metal in molds, a different process entirely
